column1: # Dedup of the applications on Daniel's system (Daniel, 2026-10-02): one tool per task,
# KDE's where it covers the task; leftovers of tasks and meta-packages go.
# actions: drop (another tool does the task), dep (a library or data package marked manual,
# it comes with its program), games (decided in the games list), aptus (closed: offered in
# APTus, not installed), hardware (installed by the hardware setup when the hardware is found)
